snippet.title: Cairn - Free On The Trail DLC Announcement Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Cairn's Free On the Trail DLC: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588550 

The Game Bakers reveal On the Trail free DLC for the critically acclaimed survival climber Cairn. On the Trail - Deep Water is the first of a series of free DLC bringing Cairn climbers with new climbing locations and fresh challenges as they follow the trail of a legendary climber. The DLC brings 3 new climbing areas, and introduces water soloing: players can now climb over water, without the consequences of plummeting to their death! Marco won't be cheering from the sideline anymore, players can now climb with him or Aava. The climb begins again in Summer 2026.

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
